scholarship_title: ER.GO Regional Scholarship 2026/2027 (Emilia-Romagna, incl. University of Modena and Reggio Emilia)
provider_organization: ER.GO (Azienda Regionale per il Diritto agli Studi Superiori, Emilia-Romagna)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Full tuition exemption for students eligible for the scholarship, plus refund of the EUR 140 regional tax (bando Sezione II art. 1)

stipend.notes: Set by ISEE band and student status. Off-site (fuori sede) students: EUR 3,585.56-7,171.11; commuters EUR 2,095.36-4,190.71; in-town EUR 1,445.08-2,890.16. +15% if ISEE up to EUR 12,500 (off-site max EUR 8,246.78); +20% for women in STEM courses (off-site max EUR 8,605.33). Extra-semester students get half. Tax-free. Paid in instalments that depend on credits earned.

additional_benefits: Housing (ER.GO residences, separate application on the same form)
Meals (part of the grant can be converted to meal credit: EUR 200-600)

application_fee.notes: No fee to ER.GO. If applying through a partner CAF, EUR 10.30 is taken from the first instalment.

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: First-year bachelor's/master's: first instalment(s) on income only, later instalments need credits by 28 Feb 2027, 10 Aug 2027 and 30 Nov 2027 or the money must be repaid. Later years: minimum credits by 10 Aug 2026 (UNIMORE webinar: 10 credits for year 2, 25 for later years).
language_proficiency: None required for the grant itself

country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is not on the 'particularly poor countries' list (D.M. 176/2026), so Nigerian students must submit full family income and property documents for 2025, issued by Nigerian authorities, legalised by the Italian embassy (or apostilled where allowed) and translated into Italian. Self-declarations are not accepted. Non-EU first-year students with family abroad are ranked in a separate list.

required_documents.name: Online application in ER.GO Dossier Utente
required_documents.detail: Confirmed with PEC or PIN if needed

required_documents.name: Each adult family member's job/activity and months worked in 2025
Official 2025 gross income certificate for each adult family member
Certificate of all buildings owned by the family at 31 Dec 2025
required_documents.detail: With size in square metres (or a statement that none are owned)

required_documents.name: Remaining mortgage and financial assets of each family member at 31 Dec 2025
Legalisation and translation of all foreign documents
required_documents.detail: Legalised (or apostilled) and translated into Italian

preparation_alerts: Combined income limits: ISEE under EUR 25,000 AND ISPE under EUR 50,000
Foreign income documents must be uploaded by the same 24 Aug 2026 16:00 deadline; late or incomplete documents mean not eligible
Legalisation at the Italian embassy and sworn translation take weeks; start in spring
Do not pay agents: the bando warns no intermediaries are needed
Off-site rate needs a documented domicile (self-certify by 3 Nov 2026, documents by 14 Jan 2027)
Enrolment at the university must be completed by the bando's enrolment deadlines

Changes: ISEE limit corrected from EUR 30,000 to EUR 25,000 (plus ISPE EUR 50,000); amount range corrected (old minimum EUR 433 was from a secondary source); dates now officially confirmed. Next cycle not announced; ER.GO opened late June in 2026. Published corrections (rettifiche) checked: none change scholarship amounts, limits or dates.
